title: Deterministic analysis packet
description: The analysis-packet.json that is everything a reader - human or model - is allowed to reason from. Upstream of this document numbers are derived by code that can be re-run; downstream of it prose is written about numbers that can no longer change. Every quantity lives in metrics under a short stable key with its own name and unit, and findings cite keys rather than restating values, so a finding cannot drift from the number it rests on. The verdict is computed here and nowhere else: kafkars.llm-summary.v1 must copy it verbatim. Documentation mirror of the AnalysisPacket serde type in crates/bench-schema/src/packet.rs, which is the source of truth.

suite.description: Experiment id of the suite behind the packet, when a suite is the source.

bundle_digests.description: Digest of every sealed bundle behind the numbers, in attempt order.

verdict.description: What the evidence says, decided by code from the suite's intervals and gates. improved and regressed are about the gated metrics; mixed means the gated metrics disagree; inconclusive means the evidence does not separate the subjects; invalid means it may not be reasoned from at all.

scenario_name.description: Scenario name, carried for readers who do not resolve ids.

subjects.description: The subjects the packet is about, in comparison order.

role.description: Absent when the subject list is unlabeled.

validity.description: How much of the underlying evidence may be believed.

runs_valid.description: Attempts whose evidence passed every performed check; never above runs_total.

claim_eligible.description: Always false in this milestone, as it is for every document here.

metrics.description: Every quantity a reader may cite, keyed by a short stable id such as M001. A metric nobody can cite by key is a metric nobody can cite.

name.description: Human name, for example 'p99 offer-to-terminal, head'.

unit.description: For example ns, records/s, bytes, ratio.

deterministic_findings.description: Statements the deterministic layer is willing to make, each citing the metrics it rests on. Every metric_refs entry must name a key this packet defines.

anomalies.description: Anything unexplained a reader must weigh before concluding. An explicit recorded gap beats an implied guarantee.

evidence_refs.description: Short key to bundle-relative path or bundle digest, so a claim can point at the file it came from without embedding a path in prose.
